scholarships.title: MOFCOM Scholarship - CSC Program (Ministry of Commerce of China and China Scholarship Council Joint Program)
scholarships.official_source: Ministry of Commerce of China (MOFCOM) & China Scholarship Council (CSC)

existing.description: The MOFCOM Scholarship is an aid programme hosted by the Ministry of Commerce of the People's Republic of China that offers postgraduate study in China to applicants from developing countries. It runs in two tracks: the MOFCOM-40 direct-admission track of 40 MOFCOM-led projects, and the MOFCOM-CSC joint track operated with the China Scholarship Council. Through the Chinese Embassy in Sierra Leone, applicants register on the CSC portal under institution code 00010, select three target universities and majors, and email the full document set to the embassy. The official programme PDF states free on-campus accommodation and annual stipends of RMB 36,000 for master's and RMB 42,000 for PhD students. Admission is decided by the receiving university.
eligibility: Senior officials of the Sierra Leonean government, university faculty or corporate executives
At least 3 years of work experience
Bachelor's degree for master's applicants; master's degree for doctoral applicants
Minimum average GPA of 3.25 on a 4-point scale, or 4.0 on a 5-point scale
Good health; physical examination at the 34th Military Hospital or Jui Hospital with the form signed and verified by a Chinese doctor
HSK Level 3 or higher is a priority (not mandatory)

Not eligible if any type of Chinese Government Scholarship funding was received in the past three years; students scheduled to graduate from a Chinese university in 2026 are barred, and those who graduated in 2023 or earlier with prior Chinese Government funding are eligible
Degree certificates and transcripts must be stamped by the Ministry of Technical and Higher Education and authenticated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
existing.eligibility_summary: For Sierra Leone: senior officials of the Sierra Leonean government, university faculty or corporate executives aged 45 or under with at least three years of work experience; a bachelor's degree for master's applicants and a master's degree for doctoral applicants; minimum GPA of 3.25 on a 4-point scale or 4.0 on a 5-point scale; good health with the specified Chinese medical examination. Applicants who have held any Chinese Government Scholarship funding in the past three years are barred from the 2026 round.
benefits: Stipend of RMB 36,000 per year for master's students
Stipend of RMB 42,000 per year for PhD students
coverage: Free on-campus accommodation (stated in the official MOFCOM-CSC programme PDF)
Monthly stipend of RMB 36,000 per year for each master's student
Monthly stipend of RMB 42,000 per year for each PhD student
requirements: Register on the CSC portal at https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/#/login and select 3 target universities/majors using institution code 00010
Complete the relevant university-specific application portal as well
Email all PDF materials plus Appendix 3 to sl@mofcom.gov.cn with the prescribed subject line
Keep the original paper copies, as submission is by email and online system only
Attend the embassy interview if invited; uninvited applicants are automatically disqualified
documents: Application form (university-specific or the MOFCOM-CSC form) as PDF
Two recommendation letters as PDF - one from the applicant's employer (government department, institution or company) and one from an academic professor
Bachelor's or master's degree certificate stamped by the Ministry of Technical and Higher Education and authenticated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (PDF)
Transcript with GPA score, with the same authentication (PDF)
Personal statement including a study or research plan of at least 1,000 words (PDF)
Foreigner Physical Examination Form (Appendix 3), completed at the 34th Military Hospital or Jui Hospital with a Chinese physician signature (PDF)
Passport copy valid at least 18 months; official or diplomatic passports are not accepted (PDF)
Police clearance / no criminal record certificate (PDF)
existing.english_requirement: Not stated on the notice; HSK Level 3 or higher gives priority in review.
application_method: CSC online registration at https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/#/login plus each university's own portal
Direct email of the complete PDF set to sl@mofcom.gov.cn by the published deadline
Embassy interview in late May 2026 for shortlisted candidates
The embassy submits a confidential shortlist; final admission is decided by the university's admission committee
existing.selection_notes: Incomplete or overdue applications are rejected. The embassy recommends candidates and the final admission decision rests with the university's admission committee. Applicants are urged to act with integrity; in previous years degrees were revoked over falsified transcripts.
existing.best_fit: Bangladeshi government officials and professionals in public administration
existing.duration: Postgraduate degree programme (master's or doctoral); the notice does not publish a fixed duration.
existing.application_period: The 2026 recruitment notice was issued 3 April 2026, materials were due 12 May 2026, interviews were expected in late May 2026 and admission results were expected July-August 2026. The programme is recruited annually.
existing.deadline_display: Applicants for MOFCOM-CSC must email their PDF materials and Appendix 3 to sl@mofcom.gov.cn by May 12, 2026; shortlisted applicants are notified in late May 2026 and results are announced around July-August 2026.
existing.program_type: Postgraduate scholarship programme run by the Ministry of Commerce of China in two tracks - the MOFCOM-40 direct-admission track and the MOFCOM-CSC joint track operated with the China Scholarship Council

scholarships.title: UCAS Chinese Government Scholarship (University of Chinese Academy of Sciences)
scholarships.official_source: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS) & China Scholarship Council (CSC)

existing.description: Entrusted by the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China, the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences recruits outstanding young graduate students from around the world for master's and doctoral study and provides full scholarships. The award exempts tuition (RMB 40,000 per year for PhD, RMB 30,000 for master's) and the RMB 600 application fee, pays a monthly stipend of RMB 5,000 for PhD and RMB 3,500 for master's students, provides free accommodation on the Beijing campus or an off-campus subsidy, and includes medical insurance of RMB 800 per person. Sponsorship runs for 36 months, with up to 12 months of permitted extension for doctoral students. Applications must be filed in both the CSC system and the UCAS admission system before the published deadline.
eligibility: Non-Chinese citizen with a valid passport, friendly to China and abiding by the laws and decrees of China and UCAS rules and regulations
Master's applicants must hold a degree or diploma equivalent to a Chinese bachelor's degree and be no more than 35 years old
PhD applicants must hold a degree or diploma equivalent to a Chinese master's degree and be no more than 40 years old
Must meet the general admission criteria for international students (2025 Enrollment Guide for international students)
Must not have accepted any other sponsorship at the time of application and cannot accept any other sponsorship during the scholarship period
Must study full time in the research institute where enrolled and may not take any other job
Applicants currently pursuing a master's or doctoral degree at any institution in China are not eligible for the corresponding programme
existing.eligibility_summary: Non-Chinese citizens holding a valid passport who are friendly to China, abide by Chinese law and UCAS rules, and are proficient in English or Mandarin. Master's applicants need a qualification equivalent to a Chinese bachelor's degree and must be 35 or under; PhD applicants need a qualification equivalent to a Chinese master's degree and must be 40 or under. Applicants must not hold any other sponsorship at the time of application or during the scholarship, and must study full time at the research institute where they are enrolled.
benefits: Full tuition waiver (RMB 40,000/year PhD, RMB 30,000/year Master's)
Monthly stipend of RMB 5,000 for PhD students
Monthly stipend of RMB 3,500 for master's students
Free accommodation on the UCAS Beijing campus or an off-campus subsidy
Comprehensive medical insurance of RMB 800 per person
coverage: Tuition fee exempted: RMB 40,000 per year for PhD students and RMB 30,000 per year for master's students

Monthly stipend: RMB 5,000 for PhD applicants (of which RMB 1,500 is provided by the supervisor or CAS institute) and RMB 3,500 for master's applicants (of which RMB 500 is provided by the supervisor or CAS institute)

Free accommodation on the UCAS Beijing campus, or an accommodation subsidy of up to RMB 700 per month for master's and general visiting students living off campus and up to RMB 1,000 per month for doctoral and senior visiting students
Medical insurance of RMB 800 per person
requirements: Log in to the Online CSC Application System at https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/#/login and submit the scholarship application; UCAS agency number 80001
Log in to the UCAS Online Admission System for International Students at https://is.ucas.ac.cn/#/login and choose 'Chinese Government Scholarship'
Submit identical information in both systems
Submit the Provisional Acceptance Form by UCAS Supervisor (Attachment 2) if a pre-admission letter is required
documents: Materials listed in the Call for 2026 Master's and Doctoral Programs for International Students
CSC application form generated by the online CSC system
Provisional Acceptance Form of International Student by UCAS Supervisor (Attachment 2) where a pre-admission letter is required
Degree requirements documentation for applicants from countries with a different education system (Attachment 1)
existing.english_requirement: Applicants must be proficient in English or Mandarin; the page sets no specific test score.
application_method: Apply through the CSC online application system using UCAS agency number 80001
Apply in parallel through the UCAS international admission system and select the Chinese Government Scholarship option
Submit identical information in both systems before the deadline
Register at the time and place stated in the Admission Notice
existing.selection_notes: Provisional acceptance forms and pre-admission letters are not the final admission list. Successful applicants must attend annual reviews and other examinations on time or the scholarship will be suspended or deprived, and during the sponsorship period they must publish research achievements with UCAS and their institutes as their academic institutions, stating that their research is funded by the Chinese Government Scholarship.
existing.best_fit: Research-oriented Bangladeshi students in science and engineering
existing.duration: Master students: 36 months (with no extension). PhD students: 36 months with permitted extension of no more than 12 months.
existing.application_period: The 2026 call set a deadline of 31 January 2026 (Beijing Time). The call is issued annually; the 2027 call had not been published as of 2026-10-04, so no date is recorded for the next cycle.
existing.deadline_display: Application deadline: January 31st, 2026 (Beijing Time), with the application filed in both the CSC system and the UCAS international admission system.
existing.program_type: Chinese Government Scholarship - Chinese University Program (UCAS as host institution, CSC agency number 80001)
